name: moe
description: Moe — one workspace for coding-agent tools and skills.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && turbo run typecheck test && pnpm hooks:test
scripts.mint:check: node scripts/mint-prepare.mjs --root . && turbo run mint:generate --force && (git diff --exit-code -- plugins .claude-plugin/marketplace.json docs/moe/generated/plugin-catalog.md && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- plugins .claude-plugin/marketplace.json docs/moe/generated/plugin-catalog.md)" || (echo '\nGenerated plugin projections are not reproducible from source. Regenerate with `pnpm mint` and commit.' && git status --short -- plugins .claude-plugin/marketplace.json docs/moe/generated/plugin-catalog.md && exit 1))
scripts.tab:test:bindings: pnpm tab:build && uv run --project packages/tab/bindings/python pytest packages/tab/bindings/python && (cd packages/tab/bindings/go && CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./...) && pnpm --filter @bubstack/moe-tab test:ffi
scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm bin:test && pnpm hooks:test
